what: Jetson USB installer media authorized; GL-RM1 needs a DisplayPort-to-HDMI video path
why: No microSD is available. The existing KVM and cable cannot currently show the firmware screen needed to choose the supported USB installation route.
details: User authorized erasing the old 16 GB SanDisk Cruzer Blade for installer use when needed; no erase or flash performed. GL-RM1 captures HDMI video and uses USB-C for USB control/power, so the available DP/USB-C cable does not feed its video input. NVIDIA supports passive or active DP-to-HDMI adapters; a direct DisplayPort monitor or separately available USB-TTL console is an alternative. JetPack 7.2.1 USB-to-NVMe installation remains conditional on confirming compatible QSPI firmware. No SSD or network settings changed.
